name: Aestima Clinic Sathorn

summary_en: Located in Sathon, Bangkok, Aestima Clinic Sathorn specializes in facial skin care services. The clinic holds a 5.0 rating across 169 reviews and has been featured in 1 Pantip discussion regarding specific patient experiences.
